This work suits fast typists who can sustain intense focus while seated. Reporters must follow speech for hours and remain sensitive to legal terms, names, and places. Strong composure matters because court proceedings cannot be replayed in real time.

paragraphs: The day centers on listening, rapid input, and review. Before court, reporters check stenography equipment and backup recordings. They record proceedings at high speed and keep pace with rapid speakers. After recess, they replay audio, fill gaps, correct words and terms, label speakers, produce an official transcript, and archive it before leaving.
